Nach {{history.experienceDative}} übergi: After {{history.experienceDative}}, Heiri Steiner is handing his company over to Clemens Fritsche. The location, the phone number and the service for all existing HS crane systems remain – complemented by engineering know-how where it is useful to you.
Wer betreut meine HS-Krananlage in Zukun: Who will look after my HS crane system in future?
Wir – ohne Unterbruch. Wir kennen die HS: We will – without interruption. We know the HS crane systems from the design to the spare part and continue to look after them.
Bauen Sie weiterhin neue Krananlagen?: Do you still build new crane systems?
Ja. Krane nach Mass und Heukrananlagen p: Yes. We continue to plan, build and install custom cranes and hay crane systems ourselves.
Bleibt die Telefonnummer gleich?: Does the phone number stay the same?
Ja, {{phone.display}}. Die aktuellen Kon: Yes, {{phone.display}}. You can find the current contact details here on our website at any time.
Ja. Das Unternehmen bleibt dasselbe, nur: Yes. The company stays the same, only the name changes.
Wie schnell sind Sie bei einem Stillstan: How quickly are you on site in case of a breakdown?
Steht eine Anlage still, rufen Sie direk: If a system is at a standstill, call us directly: {{phone.link}}. We will take care of it.
Betreuen Sie auch Krane anderer Herstell: Do you also look after cranes from other manufacturers?
Ja. Wir prüfen, warten und reparieren Kr: Yes. We inspect, maintain and repair cranes regardless of the manufacturer. We look at every crane beforehand. Whether we can source parts for a particular model is clarified case by case.
Bekomme ich weiterhin Ersatzteile für äl: Will I still get spare parts for older systems?
Ja. Die Ersatzteile für die bestehenden: Yes. The spare parts for the existing HS systems are either in stock, or we make them new for you.
